critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Daily seed is sum(ord(c) for c in 'YYYY-MM-DD') — adjacent days can collide to the same modifier (e.g. 2026-04-21 and 2026-04-12 share digits and may map close). Acceptable for MVP since it's deterministic per-day, but not perfectly distributed; consider hashlib for better distribution if needed.
server.py POST /leaderboard/speedrun returns {status:'invalid'} with HTTP 200 for total_ms<=0 instead of 400. Frontend treats this fine but a 400 would be more correct REST semantics.

server.py /daily-challenge/completed/{player_id} record DOES include 'ts' field as datetime — Mongo driver returns it serializable but client code should be aware. _id is correctly excluded via projection.

App.js handleRunComplete posts BOTH speedrun submission and daily completion when dailyMode+speedrunMode are true; correct. dailyMode auto-triggers speedrunMode in handlePlayDaily — verified via UI (yellow timer appeared without manual toggle).

MainMenu fetches /api/daily-challenge/completed/default on mount — uses hardcoded 'default' player_id. If localStorage hyperaxel_player_name differs, daily-completed status may be inconsistent across sessions. Minor.
action_items: Optional: improve daily seed distribution (use hashlib.md5(date).digest() instead of sum(ord)) for even modifier rotation across days.
